# mcp


<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

MCP, the Model Context Protocol, is how AI assistants and editors call
outside tools. `vishalakshi-mcp` is an MCP server that offers vault
methods as tools. `TOOLS` lists them. Each tool is built with the
[`cmd`](https://vedicreader.github.io/vishalakshi/cli.html#cmd) function
that the command line uses. The arguments and the description of a tool
are the arguments and the docstring of the method. The `instructions` of
the server tell a model which tool to use first. `context` comes before
answering a question. `grab` files something. `note` writes a conclusion
back.

The server treats an MCP client as an agent and never as a person. Every
tool that takes `by` is called with `by='agent'`, and the server does
not offer `by`. A client can raise a privacy level or mark a document
personal. A client cannot clear a mark, reject a finding or lower a
level (see [pii](09_pii.ipynb)).

The client is a model that the vault does not run. Every result passes
through
[`client_view`](https://vedicreader.github.io/vishalakshi/mcp.html#client_view)
before the client sees it.
[`client_view`](https://vedicreader.github.io/vishalakshi/mcp.html#client_view)
withholds each string under a Local only document, including the title,
headings and source. Every other string goes through `redact`, which
masks the identifiers of a Personal document. A document that a person
cleared with `mark_not_pii` comes back as stored. A tool that takes
`pii` defaults to `redact` here. The CLI defaults to `off`. A client may
ask for `refuse`, which withholds more. A client may not ask for `off`.
Only a person can turn the gate off, as only a person can lower a level.
`ask` returns no `prompt`. When a local model read a Local only section
whole, its answer is also withheld. To use the server, add it to the
configuration of the client:

``` json
{"mcpServers": {"vishalakshi": {"command": "vishalakshi-mcp",
                                "env": {"VISHALAKSHI_VAULT": "~/.vishalakshi/vault.db"}}}}
```

The server talks over standard input and output by default.
`vishalakshi-mcp --http` serves Streamable HTTP instead.


*Register one
[`Vault`](https://vedicreader.github.io/vishalakshi/core.html#vault)
method as an MCP tool that returns JSON through
[`client_view`](https://vedicreader.github.io/vishalakshi/mcp.html#client_view).
The tool fixes `by` to `'agent'` and hides it. The default of `pii` is
`redact`.*

### client_view

``` python
def client_view(
    o, v, ner:bool=False
):
```

*Return what an MCP client receives for a result. Each string under a
Local only document is withheld. Every other string goes through
`redact`, except in a cleared document, which is returned as stored. The
result has no `prompt`.*

     'The retrieval an LLM should be handed: whole sections plus what they connect to. sections carry `text, breadcrumb, pages')

``` python
import os, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from vishalakshi import Vault
from vishalakshi.cli import vault
```

``` python
def schema(t): return getattr(t, 'input_schema', None) or t.inputSchema   # renamed in mcp 2.0

test_eq(sorted(tools), sorted(TOOLS))
test_eq(schema(tools['search'])['properties']['limit']['default'], 10)
test_eq(schema(tools['search'])['required'], ['q'])
# the docments on the Vault method are what a client reads, so they have to survive the round trip
assert 'invoice' in tools['categorize'].description
test_eq(schema(tools['extract'])['required'], ['ref'])
test_eq(schema(tools['ask_doc'])['required'], ['ref', 'question'])
# an MCP client is an agent: it cannot say it is a person, so it cannot clear a mark
assert 'by' not in schema(tools['mark_not_pii'])['properties']
_mv = Vault(str(Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())/'m.db'), offline=True)
_mv.note('A letter about the garden.', title='letter')
_old = {k: os.environ.get(k) for k in ('VISHALAKSHI_VAULT', 'VISHALAKSHI_OFFLINE')}
os.environ.update(VISHALAKSHI_VAULT=str(_mv.path), VISHALAKSHI_OFFLINE='1'); vault.cache_clear()
try:
    await mcp.call_tool('mark_not_pii', dict(ref='letter'))
    _err = ''
except Exception as e: _err = str(e)
assert 'person' in _err, _err
test_eq(_mv.marks('letter').get('pii_override'), None)
for _k, _x in _old.items():
    if _x is None: os.environ.pop(_k, None)
    else: os.environ[_k] = _x
vault.cache_clear()
```

``` python
from vishalakshi.ask import use_chat
```

``` python
# what a client is handed by default: no Personal identifier and nothing of a Local only document, title included
_pv = Vault(str(Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())/'p.db'), offline=True)
_pv.note('Write to jane.doe@example.com about the orchard and the garden wall.', title='orchard letter')
_pv.note('The orchard ledger for the garden: what the trees cost.', title='Zanzibar ledger')
_pv.set_level('Zanzibar', 'local')
_pv.note('Rank fusion for the orchard and garden search.', title='fusion note')
_pd, _ld = _pv.doc('orchard letter')['id'], _pv.doc('Zanzibar')['id']
class _Echo:
    "A chat on this machine that repeats its prompt, the most a model could hand back of what it read."
    def __init__(self, model=None, **kw): self.runtime = 'litert'
    def __call__(self, p): return dict(content=p)
_q = dict(q='orchard garden')
_calls = [('search', _q), ('sections', _q), ('context', dict(_q, code=0)), ('federate', _q), ('toc', {}), ('sources', {}),
          ('read', dict(node_id=f'{_ld}#1')), ('read', dict(node_id=f'{_pd}#1')), ('related', dict(node_id=f'{_pd}#1')),
          ('document', dict(ref=_ld)), ('document', dict(ref=_pd)), ('pii', dict(ref=_ld)), ('pii', dict(ref=_pd)),
          ('level', dict(ref=_ld)), ('ner', dict(ref=_pd)), ('ask', dict(question='what about the orchard?', code=0)),
          ('ask_doc', dict(ref=_ld, question='what does it cost?')), ('ask_doc', dict(ref=_pd, question='who to write to?'))]
_old = {k: os.environ.get(k) for k in ('VISHALAKSHI_VAULT', 'VISHALAKSHI_OFFLINE')}
os.environ.update(VISHALAKSHI_VAULT=str(_pv.path), VISHALAKSHI_OFFLINE='1'); vault.cache_clear()
try:
    with use_chat(_Echo): _outs = [(n, str(await mcp.call_tool(n, a))) for n, a in _calls]
    test_eq([(n, w) for n, s in _outs for w in ('jane.doe@example.com', 'Zanzibar') if w in s], [])
    # ids and Open text come through, so the client can still ask again
    assert _ld in dict(_outs)['level'] and 'Rank fusion' in dict(_outs)['search']
    test_eq(schema(tools['search'])['properties']['pii']['default'], 'redact')
    # an agent may ask for more masking, never for less: `off` is a person's call, made at the command line
    assert 'jane.doe' not in str(await mcp.call_tool('read', dict(node_id=f'{_pd}#1', pii='refuse')))
    try: await mcp.call_tool('search', dict(_q, pii='off')); _err = ''
    except Exception as e: _err = str(e)
    assert 'person' in _err, _err
    # a document a person cleared comes back as stored
    _pv.mark_not_pii(_pd)
    assert 'jane.doe@example.com' in str(await mcp.call_tool('document', dict(ref=_pd)))
finally:
    for _k, _x in _old.items():
        if _x is None: os.environ.pop(_k, None)
        else: os.environ[_k] = _x
    vault.cache_clear()
```
